# Dialog

Open focused content above the page with modal or non-modal behavior.

## Examples

### Modal

Keep focus inside the open dialog and restore it to the trigger when the dialog closes.

<ComponentExample component="dialog" scenario="modal" title="Modal" description="Keep focus inside the open dialog and restore it to the trigger when the dialog closes." :index="0" />

### Non modal

Leave surrounding content interactive while the dialog remains open.

<ComponentExample component="dialog" scenario="non-modal" title="Non modal" description="Leave surrounding content interactive while the dialog remains open." :index="1" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the trigger or focused action. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift+Tab</kbd> | Move through available controls; modal content keeps focus inside. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the popup and restore focus when configured. |

## Accessibility

The dialog connects title and description, traps focus only in modal mode, and restores focus when it closes.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/) for the host accessibility contract.
